zones.name: Ashen Campsite
zones.desc: Formerly a Legion outpost overseeing the Muspel Volcano Zone, it fell into ruin following a volcanic eruption. It now serves as the base of a cult that worships the volcano.

zones.name: Cursed Snowfield Hideout
zones.desc: A Karas den located in northern Morheim. Originally a hideout for a small group of Nornir, it was eventually raided by the Balaur. Most of its inhabitants were either murdered for resisting or processed as materials for Fafnite, leaving behind a cursed legacy that deters anyone from approaching the area.

zones.name: Dharvata Surveillance Base
zones.desc: A Balaur surveillance base built to aid the search for the Ascension Artifact. Functionally a forward base, it collects intel from the fake Fate Archons and reports any findings to the Fafnir Brigade's main forces. The base is littered with Fafnium, which is used to trap the souls of Daeva captured by the fake Fate Archons. Much of the victims tend to be Kromede's followers.

zones.name: Dinakra Sky Outpost
zones.desc: A floating island that broke away during the collapse of the Arkanis Sky Temple, now serving as a Balaur sky outpost. It is overseen by Dinakra, a Balaur who is content with his rank of outpost captain and has little interest in pursuing greater power.

zones.name: Fallen Temple Ruins
zones.desc: The ruins of a temple on a sky island, brought down by a direct strike from a Balaur Dredgion. It has since become the lair of renegade Daeva, who extort and murder any other Daeva who cross their path.

zones.name: Ice Canyon Campsite
zones.desc: A former camp for lumberjacks and hunters from the days when the Patamor Plains were still a forest. Long abandoned, it was rumored to have been resettled by outsiders. Now, only their ghosts roam the site, alongside fearless outlaws who have turned the haunted camp into their base of operations.
